history.name: Whichever agent the team already uses
history.description: The standing instruction is written into whichever agent instruction files a project already has, covering the common ones across the current tools, and a project with none gets the neutral file most of them read. Which files to write can be named explicitly, and the wiring can be turned off entirely.
history.dev_notes: AGENT_FILES in init.mjs maps claude/agents/gemini/cursor/copilot/windsurf to their paths; --agents takes auto (default), none, or a comma-separated list.
